summary: Merges the two parameters into a bit-field value, using a mask argument a1 to decide which bits come from a2 and which are inherited from an existing bit-field read via sub_5950A3(): v2 = (a2 & a1) | (~a2 & sub_5950A3()). The merged value is stored via sub_595135(v2) and also returned.

operations.description: Read the current bit-field value by calling sub_5950A3() as the inherited-mask source.
Merge: v2 = (a2 & a1) | (~a2 & sub_5950A3()), where a1 selects a2's bits and the complement of a2 inherits from the existing value.
Persist the merged value by calling sub_595135(v2).

unresolved: The meaning of the bit-field read by sub_5950A3 and the store performed by sub_595135 is not established; both callees are unanalysed here.
The single caller sub_59508D supplies the two parameters, but its context is not in this packet.
